title: draba oligosperma subsp. subsessilis
intro: Draba oligosperma subsp. subsessilis, commonly known as Draba subsessilis, is a plant species in the mustard family, Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Draba oligosperma subsp. subsessilis include its ability to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
